places.name: Alexander Nevsky Cathedral
places.ai_summary: Alexander Nevsky Cathedral is one of the largest Eastern Orthodox cathedrals in the world, known for its stunning gold-domed architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Opening hours may vary during religious services.

places.place_tip: Visit early in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.name: Boyana Church (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: Boyana Church is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for its medieval frescoes and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance as entry is limited to small groups.

places.name: Vitosha Mountain & Simeonovo Lift
places.ai_summary: Vitosha Mountain offers hiking, skiing, and panoramic views of Sofia, accessible via the Simeonovo Lift.

opening_hours.notes: Lift operating hours may vary depending on weather conditions.

places.place_tip: Wear appropriate clothing for the season and bring water.

places.name: National Palace of Culture (NDK)
places.ai_summary: The National Palace of Culture is a multifunctional complex in Sofia, hosting various cultural events, exhibitions, and concerts.

opening_hours.notes: Check the official website for event schedules and ticket prices.

places.place_tip: Visit the official website to check for events and exhibitions during your visit.

places.name: Ivan Vazov National Theatre
places.ai_summary: The Ivan Vazov National Theatre is the national theatre of Bulgaria, known for its impressive architecture and vibrant cultural scene.

opening_hours.notes: Check the official website for performance schedules and ticket prices.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular performances.

places.name: Banya Bashi Mosque
places.ai_summary: Banya Bashi Mosque is a functioning mosque in Sofia, known for its unique architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Visitors are advised to dress modestly and remove shoes before entering.

places.place_tip: Visit during prayer times to experience the mosque's atmosphere.

places.name: Serdica Roman Ruins
places.ai_summary: The Serdica Roman Ruins are ancient ruins in the heart of Sofia, offering a glimpse into the city's Roman past.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted during archaeological excavations.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the nearby St. George Rotunda.

places.ai_summary: Borisova Gradina is the oldest and most famous park in Sofia, offering beautiful gardens, walking paths, and a lake.

opening_hours.notes: The park is open year-round.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike or take a leisurely walk to explore the park.

places.ai_summary: The National Art Gallery in Sofia houses an extensive collection of Bulgarian and foreign art, including paintings, sculptures, and decorative arts.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions and events.

places.name: Sofia Synagogue
places.ai_summary: The Sofia Synagogue is one of the largest synagogues in Europe, known for its impressive architecture and rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Visitors are advised to dress modestly.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn more about the synagogue's history.

places.name: Vitosha Boulevard (Shopping Street)
places.ai_summary: Vitosha Boulevard is the main commercial street in Sofia, lined with shops, cafes, and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Individual store hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for unique shops and cafes.

places.name: Vitosha Nature Park Trails
places.ai_summary: The Vitosha Nature Park offers various trails for hiking and exploring the natural beauty surrounding Sofia.

opening_hours.notes: The park is open year-round.

places.place_tip: Bring plenty of water and snacks, and wear sturdy hiking shoes.

places.ai_summary: Sofia Zoo is the oldest and largest zoo in Bulgaria, home to a wide variety of animals and plants.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from November to March.

places.place_tip: Check the zoo's schedule for feeding times and special events.
